text: U.S. announces total blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, replacingn conditional passage frameworks with complete restriction of all vessel movement. Prior negotiation and ceasefire structures are displaced by a singular enforcement regime. Control over transit becomes exclusively defined by interdiction rather than negotiated access conditions.

meta.note: Resolution applies to control method, not broader conflict state.

text: Oil prices rise above prior levels as U.S. naval blockade restricts vessel movement into and out of Iranian ports. Supply pathways narrow while enforcement extends across multiple maritime zones. Market pricing synchronizes with reduced accessible flow and expanded geographic scope of transit restriction.

meta.note: Expansion reflects widened enforcement perimeter, not increased flow capacity.
